inputs.note: lab_result_idempotency_key and lab_result_extraction_id over a re-submitted result, and a request carrying two results that share a key.

expected: The same result submitted twice composes the same key and the same extraction id, canonicalising digest case and test-code whitespace; two different results never collide; a request carrying a duplicate key is refused before it is sent.
guards_against: Broken idempotency on write-back: a second upload of the same report writing a second set of results into a chart (invariant 6).
